name: Poly Haven
description_it: Texture PBR, HDRI e modelli 3D di alta qualità, tutti in pubblico dominio (CC0).
description_en: High-quality PBR textures, HDRIs and 3D models, all public domain (CC0).

name: ambientCG
description_it: Migliaia di materiali PBR, HDRI e modelli in pubblico dominio (CC0), anche per uso commerciale.
description_en: Thousands of public domain (CC0) PBR materials, HDRIs and models, commercial use included.

name: cgbookcase
description_it: Texture PBR fotografiche in pubblico dominio, con mappe complete fino all'8K.
description_en: Public domain photographic PBR textures with full maps up to 8K.

name: ShareTextures
description_it: Texture, modelli e atlanti di vegetazione in CC0, pensati anche per l'architettura.
description_en: CC0 textures, models and vegetation atlases, designed with architecture in mind.

name: 3DTextures
description_it: Texture PBR seamless gratuite (pietra, legno, metallo, tessuti) con mappe complete.
description_en: Free seamless PBR textures (stone, wood, metal, fabric) with full maps.

name: Free PBR
description_it: Materiali PBR gratuiti in 2K per motori di rendering e real time.
description_en: Free 2K PBR materials for rendering engines and real time.

name: Architextures
description_it: Libreria di oltre 8.000 texture seamless di materiali architettonici e generatore di pattern; Pro a pagamento.
description_en: Library of 8,000+ seamless architectural material textures and a pattern generator; paid Pro.

name: Textures.com
description_it: Enorme archivio di texture fotografiche e PBR; con l'account gratuito si scaricano crediti giornalieri.
description_en: Huge archive of photographic and PBR textures; free accounts get daily download credits.

name: Material Maker
description_it: Crea materiali procedurali PBR con un editor a nodi, alternativa libera a Substance Designer.
description_en: Create procedural PBR materials with a node editor, a free alternative to Substance Designer.

name: 3D Warehouse
description_it: La più grande libreria di modelli SketchUp: arredi, edifici, prodotti dei produttori.
description_en: The largest library of SketchUp models: furniture, buildings, manufacturer products.

name: Sketchfab
description_it: Piattaforma di modelli 3D con migliaia di download gratuiti in Creative Commons, inclusi rilievi di edifici storici.
description_en: 3D model platform with thousands of free Creative Commons downloads, including scans of historic buildings.

name: Fab
description_it: Marketplace di Epic Games per asset 3D, materiali e Megascans, con una sezione di contenuti gratuiti.
description_en: Epic Games marketplace for 3D assets, materials and Megascans, with a free content section.

name: Blendkit (ex BlenderKit)
description_it: Libreria di modelli, materiali e HDRI integrata in Blender; molti asset gratuiti, altri in abbonamento.
description_en: Library of models, materials and HDRIs integrated in Blender; many free assets, others by subscription.

name: BIMobject
description_it: Oggetti BIM dei produttori (famiglie Revit, Archicad, IFC, SketchUp) da scaricare gratis.
description_en: Manufacturer BIM objects (Revit families, Archicad, IFC, SketchUp) free to download.

name: NBS BIM Library
description_it: Oggetti BIM di produttori britannici ed europei, con dati tecnici conformi agli standard.
description_en: BIM objects from UK and European manufacturers, with standards-compliant technical data.

name: Archiproducts
description_it: Catalogo di prodotti di design e architettura con schede tecniche e molti file CAD/BIM da scaricare.
description_en: Catalogue of design and architecture products with technical sheets and many CAD/BIM downloads.

name: Scan The World
description_it: Archivio aperto di scansioni 3D di sculture, monumenti e opere d'arte, pronte per la stampa 3D.
description_en: Open archive of 3D scans of sculptures, monuments and artworks, ready for 3D printing.
